title: Ingest handshake & signalmap scratchpad
content:
Purpose / quick summary:
- Personal scratchpad for the ingest handshake flakiness seen 2026-02-20 → ongoing. Focusing on the hook / signalmap layer that routes traces and log batches into the processing pipeline. Trying to capture commands run, immediate observations, and short hypotheses.

Timeline highlights (short):
- 2026-02-20 09:12 UTC: first customer report (high missing-span rate for service X)
- 2026-02-20 09:40 UTC: small correlated bump in consumer lag on topic `obs-ingest-events`
- 2026-02-21 02:05 UTC: transient 502 from ingest-proxy during autoscale event
- 2026-02-23 14:30 UTC: reproducer run (local replay) showed ~12% of traces dropped at handshake stage

Things I tried (commands + quick results):
- curl to /v1/ingest/handshake (local):
  curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"svc-x","pid":1234}' "https://ingest.dev.redwood/api/v1/handshake"
  -> 202 Accepted, body: {"session_id":"s-abc123","backend":"relay-2"}

- Replayed an archived trace bundle through replay tool (replayctl):
  ./replayctl --topic obs-ingest-events --file sample-20260220.ndjson --rate 400
  -> observed handshake timeouts (~timeout=20s) on ~11% of items. Handshake logs show `no matching signalmap entry` for many dropped items.

- Checked consumer offsets / lags (kafka):
  kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka1:9092 --describe --group obs-ingest-consumers
  -> consumer-2 lag spikes on partition 6 (avg lag 18k), others normal

- Pod logs: search for 'handshake' and 'signalmap'
  kubectl -n observability logs ingest-worker-2 | grep -i handshake -n
  -> sample: 2026-02-23T14:32:10Z ingest-worker-2 ERROR handshake.go:88 "signalmap lookup failed: key not found (svc-x::env=prod)"

- Snapshot of handshake layer metrics (prometheus):
  sum(handshake_failures_total) by (reason) => reason: "signalmap_miss" = 1243 in 24h

Error snippets (raw-ish):
- "signalmap lookup failed: key not found (svc-x::env=prod)"
- "handshake deadline exceeded (context canceled)"
- consumer stack: "kafka.errors.UncheckedClientError: Unexpected partition count change" (rare)

Observations / patterns:
- Most misses are for services with recent deploys (svc-x, svc-y) — suggests signalmap updates aren't propagating atomically at deploy time.
- Timing correlation with autoscaler events and relay restarts. When relay restarts, handshake_success_rate dips for ~30–90s.
- Missing items often have metadata keys present but with slightly different tagging (e.g., "env:production" vs "env:prod") — downstream lookup is exact-match.

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Signalmap cache invalidation race: new mapping published but some relays use old cache leading to misses until full TTL expires.
2) Partial metadata normalization: client tagging differences after recent SDK change (tag renames), causing key mismatch at lookup.
3) Consumer partition reshuffle during scaling causes ephemeral reordering leading to handshake timeouts and discarded items.

Quick experiments to validate (notes + results):
- Force immediate signalmap refresh on all relays (via /admin/refresh-signalmap). After refresh, replay run reduced misses from 11% → 2% (good sign).
- Normalization check: re-run replay with normalization shim that coerces env->prod alias. Misses drop by ~60% on svc-y payloads.
- Simulate partition rebalance by forcing consumer restart on node (kafka) — saw transient handshake deadline exceed but no persistent misses.

Immediate next steps / TODOs:
- (High) Add a short-lived deploy that logs signalmap version on handshake success/failure to detect staleness window (small change in worker).
- (Medium) Add tolerant lookup mode with alias table for env tags (prod/production/prod-eu).
- (Medium) Coordinate with SDK team to freeze tag rename planned for next week (Ravi).
- (Low) Add prom alert for >5% signalmap_miss sustained 10min.

Notes for postmortem/fragments to capture:
- Capture relay restart times (k8s events) and correlate with handshake_miss spikes (prometheus) and consumer lag (kafka).
- Keep current replay artifacts: sample-20260220.ndjson (bucket: gs://obs-replay/drafts/)

Unresolved questions / things to verify:
- Are there any edge cases where signalmap keys are hashed differently depending on relay region? (Sofia to check relay config)
- Does the publish path for signalmap guarantee all relays receive the new version before commit? (looking at publish pipeline: CMS -> distrib-service -> relay cache invalidation)

Useful commands / snippets (save here):
- to tail handshake errors across all workers:
  kubectl -n observability logs -l app=ingest-worker --tail=200 | grep -i "signalmap" -n
- to list relay pods with signalmap version annotation:
  kubectl -n observability get pods -l app=relay -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,SM:.metadata.annotations\"signalmap-version\"

Attachments / artifacts I left around:
- replay bundle: gs://obs-replay/drafts/sample-20260220.ndjson
- small go patch (handshake-debug) on my fork: https://github.com/leahm/redwood-ingest/compare/handshake-debug
- Jira: OBS-1297 (ingest handshake misses)

Personal notes:
- Keep this doc terse. If we confirm cache invalidation race, short fix = add atomic publish + version check at relay handshake. Longer-term = add aliasing and fuzzy lookup fallback.
- Will sync with Ravi + Sofia tomorrow 10:30 PT to decide immediate mitigations and postmortem scope.

End of scratchpad.
